fix.message: The low-poly look module is not used: start from scripts/new-lesson.mjs (a game: /skills/play/learning-game/scripts/new-game.mjs low-poly) and build with const look = lowPolyLook(THREE, kit).
Own materials break the facets: build every part with look.facet(geometry, colour, name) or the look's builders (one matte material, colour per triangle from the palette).
kit materials and textures are smooth or patterned; a low-poly scene is flat facets in the palette only: use look.facet(geometry, colour, name) or the builders.

note.message: No low-poly builders used: build the place and its parts with the look's builders (references/recipes.md).
No stage flags: each stage of the process is a spot in the landscape with a numbered paper flag the learner presses (look.flag; references/teaching.md).
Nothing travels the route: a traveller (a droplet, a truck, a boat) carrying the flow along a path shows how the stages connect (look.follow with a lookPath; references/teaching.md).
No amount in the scene: show the quantity the lesson is about as a pile, a level or a cut-paper number in the landscape, not only on the panel (references/teaching.md).
Smooth, high-segment geometry reads as plastic, not cut paper: 5 to 8 sides on cylinders and cones, detail 0 or 1 on icosahedra (references/mistakes.md).
The water stands still: call look.update(time) in update() so the sea and rivers heave.
